games.title: smb
games.assessment_reason: Initial negative median was not reproduced at the same magnitude. Five-pair follow-up median difference is one 15.625ms CPU timer tick; mixed paired outcomes and substantial within-trial variation do not establish a reproducible regression. Trials use different fixed affinities and are retained separately, never pooled.

performance_disposition.per_game_rule: No aggregate offset; Metroid observed positive, SMB3/SMB1/Gumshoe/Zelda neutral-inconclusive. No universal win claimed.
limitations: One shared Windows host under measured concurrent load; no cross-host or netplay compatibility claim.
Mixed trial outcomes within variation are inconclusive, including SMB1 follow-up.
Old and new correctness compares do not require save-state backward compatibility.

required: Inspect final results Markdown/JSON and retained archive inventory.
Verify actual remote PR head, base and diff match reviewed code and evidence.
Verify durable owning and campaign Beads updates.
final_gate.note: This preliminary evidence record does not authorize advancing the serial burndown or merging/releasing.

limitations: Qualified scanlines 240 through 260, stable interior only; includes ordinary rendering-enabled VBlank. Existing DOT_BLANK path remains. No CPU instructions or guest cycles are skipped.

Content-qualified polling-loop replacement, visible rendering-disabled bulk output, scanline crossing, PAL and additional boards remain residual opportunities; this is a scoped evaluation, not architectural exhaustion.
NMI admission requires equal sampled/output level and no pending edge. Device/event boundaries, register settling, DMA/IRQ, trace, HD recording and unsupported configurations retain working adapters.

HLE/LLE native-versus-coupled four-board/four-alignment fixtures pass high NMI, decay deadlines, register/status transitions, visible sprite output, DMA/IRQ/trace/PAL refusal, device/memory/picture/PCM and current snapshot replay.

Only actual selected hardware-machine and PPU objects are replaced, using each original object own compile recipe. Other objects, packages and Zelda canvas order/identity are preserved. These are frozen relink experiments, not claims of five fresh supported regenerations.

Actual four-stock plus Zelda Fit correctness and current-build restored gameplay checks pass. Feature profiles, other platforms/backends and final combined supported five-title/CLI regeneration and owner approval remain pending.

Local PC capacity permits coexistence; it is not a quiet-host performance guarantee. Three matched pairs plus excluded warmups per first trial; timer quantum and substantial variation are visible. SMB1 five-pair follow-up retained separately; do not pool affinities or count all raw median signs as wins.

Metroid is positive in all three sampled pairs. SMB3, SMB1, Gumshoe and Zelda are neutral/inconclusive; no reproducible individual regression established. Retain exact negative samples/medians for later final combined review.
Native save-state backward compatibility is not required. Native persistent owner saves/settings were isolated and preserved.
Background QA was hidden and muted. No owner-facing game handoff, merge or release yet.

storage.retained: Frozen source-blank-v1, products-blank-v1, fixture builds and validation records retained for final integration; no owner files or saves touched
